---
# ============================================================================
# ERN home page. Edit the copy here, then rebuild:
#
#     quarto render index.qmd
#
# That overwrites index.html in place. git is the safety net — review
# `git diff index.html` before committing.
#
# The page chrome lives in _extensions/ern/home/template.html. Everything a
# person normally wants to change (headings, blurbs, cards, links, footer)
# is a field below, so the template should rarely need touching.
#
# NOTE: Quarto parses these values as Markdown with smart typography on, so a
# bare apostrophe becomes a curly one. Write &#39; to keep it straight, which
# is what the rest of the site uses. Do not backslash-escape: inside a folded
# block scalar (>-) YAML keeps the backslash and it lands on the page.
# Colons and URLs need no escaping.
#
# The two maps under maps/ carry their own copy and their own data. The
# coverage map's roster is generated — see code/build_home_map_data.py.
# ============================================================================

title: "Eviction Research Network — eviction data across the US"

meta:
  canonical: "https://evictionresearch.net/"
  author: "Eviction Research Network, UC Berkeley"
  og_title: "Eviction Research Network — UC Berkeley"
  og_image: "https://evictionresearch.net/images/ern_logo/1Av2/EvictionStudy_logo_v09_1A_LOGO_BANNER.png"
  description: >-
    The Eviction Research Network (ERN) at UC Berkeley collects, analyzes, and
    maps eviction data to expose racial and gender disparities and drive
    evidence into housing policy. Home of the Housing Precarity Risk Model
    (HPRM) and state-level eviction research across the United States.
  short_description: >-
    Eviction data, displacement research, and the Housing Precarity Risk Model
    from UC Berkeley&#39;s Eviction Research Network.
  keywords: >-
    eviction research, housing precarity, displacement, gentrification,
    eviction data, housing policy, Housing Precarity Risk Model, HPRM,
    UC Berkeley, Department of Sociology

logos:
  logo: "images/ern_logo/1Av2/EvictionStudy_logo_v09_1A_LOGO_BANNER.png"
  logo_reversed: "images/ern_logo/1Av2/EvictionStudy_logo_v09_1A_LOGO_BANNER_REV.png"

social:
  - url: "https://bsky.app/profile/evictionresearch.bsky.social"
  - url: "https://twitter.com/EvictionNet"
  - url: "https://www.linkedin.com/company/evictionresearch/"

# newtab: true on anything that leaves the page. In-page anchors are left off
# it deliberately — a new tab would defeat the jump.
nav:
  - label: "Maps &amp; Profiles"
    href: "#atlas"
  - label: "HPRM"
    href: "https://evictionresearch.net/hprm/"
    newtab: true
  - label: "Research"
    href: "#research"
  - label: "About"
    href: "about.html"
    newtab: true
  - label: "Contact"
    href: "#partner"
    button: true

atlas:
  h1_lead: "Eviction data across the"
  h1_em: "US."
  lede: "An atlas of eviction data across the US showing what&#39;s available."
  badge: "Under development"
  note: >-
    We&#39;re still building this out — states and sources are being added as we
    verify them. Check back for more data.
  # Counts are printed by code/build_home_map_data.py on every run. Rerun it
  # after the directory changes and bring these into line.
  meta: >-
    Last updated <strong>August 2026</strong> · 50 states and D.C. ·
    <strong>8</strong> with an ERN profile, <strong>5</strong> with no public
    source.
  button:
    label: "See every state&#39;s data →"
    href: "all_states/"
  map:
    src: "maps/us-coverage-map.html"
    title: "Eviction data across the US — select a state"
    height: 800

hprm:
  h2_lead: "The Housing Precarity"
  h2_em: "Risk Model."
  sub: >-
    HPRM 2.0 scores every neighborhood in the country for eviction risk and
    market displacement risk on one scale, designed on decades of
    gentrification, displacement, and housing precarity research.
  button:
    label: "Explore the model →"
    href: "https://evictionresearch.net/hprm/"
  # The raster inside this map is rendered for the width this column gives it.
  # Widen the column and the tract marks need re-tuning — see
  # code/render_hprm_national.mjs.
  map:
    src: "maps/us-hprm-map.html"
    title: "HPRM 2.0 national risk map"
    height: 520

research:
  h2_lead: "Our"
  h2_em: "research."
  more_label: "Read more →"
  button:
    label: "All research →"
    href: "research.html"
  cards:
    - kicker: "Working paper · 2026"
      title: >-
        Keeping People in Their Homes: the impact of emergency rental
        assistance on evictions
      body: >-
        A neighborhood-level evaluation of whether $46.6 billion in emergency
        rental assistance reduced eviction filings, across 700+ counties and
        12,000+ census tracts in 22 states.
      href: "https://evictionresearch.net/hud-era/"
    - kicker: "State profile · 2026"
      title: "Washington eviction filings, 2016–2026"
      body: >-
        Over the past 36 months, 1 in 45 renter households faced an eviction
        filing, roughly 49% above the pre-pandemic normal. Seven of 39 counties
        exceed the state rate.
      href: "https://evictionresearch.net/washington/"
    - kicker: "Cityscape (HUD) · 2024"
      title: >-
        Toward a national eviction data collection strategy using natural
        language processing
      body: >-
        How ERN mined 111,740 Washington court records buried in scanned PDFs
        and handwritten paper to expose the racial and gender disparities
        structured data could not see.
      href: "cityscape-2024.html"

mission:
  eyebrow: "Research for social good"
  h2_lead: "What we"
  h2_em: "do."
  # Client-supplied ERN description. Kept verbatim.
  paragraphs:
    - >-
      The Eviction Research Network collects, analyzes, and maps eviction data
      while helping other researchers do the same. We specialize in using
      social and data science to analyze racial and gender disparities in
      eviction — and urban theory to help explain our findings.
    - >-
      Our goal is to expand public and scholarly knowledge on the prevalence
      and drivers of evictions in under-studied regions, highlight work from
      scholars in the field, and provide evidence-based research that
      legislatures, practitioners, and advocates can use to inform policy.

partner:
  eyebrow: "Partner with ERN"
  heading: "Working on eviction where the data is thin?"
  body: >-
    We collect and analyze court records, build data pipelines, train
    collaborators, and co-author research with courts, legal aid
    organizations, agencies, advocates, and universities. If you have records
    no one has analyzed — or need help with the ones you have — get in touch.
  primary:
    label: "Start a conversation →"
    href: "mailto:evictions@berkeley.edu?Subject=Partnership%20inquiry%20via%20ERN%20website"
  secondary:
    label: "See how we work →"
    href: "methodology.html"

site_footer:
  # Canonical wording from library/ORG.md. Do not paraphrase, and never write
  # "housed in" — it reads as a campus unit.
  affiliation: >-
    A research program led by Dr. Tim Thomas, Assistant Researcher in the UC
    Berkeley Department of Sociology, which serves as its academic home.
    Affiliated with the Berkeley Institute for Data Science.
  collaborators: >-
    Collaborators: Housing Initiative at Penn · Urban Displacement Project ·
    Legal Services Corporation.
  copyright: "© 2026 Eviction Research Network · University of California, Berkeley"
  accessibility:
    label: "Report a web accessibility issue"
    href: "https://dap.berkeley.edu/get-help/report-web-accessibility-issue"
  columns:
    - heading: "Data"
      links:
        - label: "Maps &amp; profiles"
          href: "#atlas"
        - label: "HPRM risk maps"
          href: "https://evictionresearch.net/hprm/"
          newtab: true
        - label: "U.S. Eviction Data Directory"
          href: "all_states/"
          newtab: true
    - heading: "Research"
      links:
        - label: "Publications"
          href: "research.html"
          newtab: true
        - label: "Methodology"
          href: "methodology.html"
          newtab: true
        - label: "Understanding eviction"
          href: "understanding-eviction.html"
          newtab: true
        - label: "News &amp; press"
          href: "news.html"
          newtab: true
    - heading: "Contact"
      links:
        - label: "evictions@berkeley.edu"
          href: "mailto:evictions@berkeley.edu?Subject=Contact%20through%20website"
        - label: "Bluesky"
          href: "https://bsky.app/profile/evictionresearch.bsky.social"
          newtab: true
        - label: "LinkedIn"
          href: "https://www.linkedin.com/company/evictionresearch/"
          newtab: true
        - label: "GitHub"
          href: "https://github.com/evictionresearch"
          newtab: true

format: home-html
output-file: index.html
---
